verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents bi-directional sync between Jira tasks and a code repository's issue tracker. The Bitbucket items ('view development status without leaving Jira', automation that 'keeps Jira up to date') describe one-way development-status visibility, an adjacent feature. Trello sync does not involve a code repository's issue tracker, and the 3000+ Marketplace apps are third-party extensions rather than Jira's own capability.
